## TemplateEngine.compileDescription() method

Compiles description blocks from a template into executable functions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static compileDescription(template: string, baseBlocks?: ReturnType<typeof TemplateEngine._processBaseBlocks>): {
        [baseId: string]: {
            [scope: string]: {
                [lang: string]: (data?: Record<string, any>) => string;
            };
        };
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[baseId: string\]: { \[scope: string\]: { \[lang: string\]: (data?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;) =&gt; string; }; }; }

Compiled description functions organized by base ID, scope, and language

## Remarks

This method parses `<description>` blocks from the template and compiles them into functions that generate rendered description strings. The result is organized by base ID, scope, and language. Used for Telegram bot command descriptions.

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <base>
    <description>Start the bot</description>
    <description scope="chat_administrators">Admin command</description>
  </base>
`;
const descriptions = TemplateEngine.compileDescription(template);
const result = descriptions.default.default.default({});
// Result: 'Start the bot'
```
